exposure: psychosocial risk (as determined by the Perinatal Integrated Psychosocial Assessment (PIPA) tool)
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth at ≥20 weeks of gestation in 2017-2019 at a tertiary maternity hospital in Sydney, Australia
finding: Women identified as high psychosocial risk by the PIPA tool had increased risk of adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was modestly increased in women with medium-high/high psychosocial risk (aOR 1.12 [95% CI 1.00-1.27]).
